lede: The biggest thing to watch this week is the Telluride Medical Center's special board meeting on Monday, where trustees take up a formal due diligence engagement with CommonSpirit Health — one of the country's largest hospital systems — a move that signals a potential partnership or affiliation is being seriously evaluated. Also on the agenda around the valley: Ouray City Council holds a public hearing on its 2027 budget and votes on utility rate ordinances, Telluride's Ecology Commission takes up a draft ordinance to phase out gas-powered lawn equipment by 2028–2030, and Mountainfilm for Locals runs Monday and Tuesday for those looking for a reason to get out of the house.

notable.stake: Board votes on CommonSpirit due diligence — a potential hospital affiliation is at stake.
Public hearing and second-reading votes on Ouray's 2027 budget and utility rates.
Draft ordinance would ban gas-powered lawn equipment in Telluride by 2028–2030.
P&Z Chair votes on merging two lots in Telluride's Historic Residential zone.
